name: 2027 AEA Conference on Teaching and Research in Economic Education (CTREE)
organizer: American Economic Association, Committee on Economic Education (AEA-CEE)
call_type: Papers, complete sessions, posters, panels and workshops
deadline_note: Same deadline for volunteering as chair or discussant.
submission_requirements: Abstract of max. 300 words via the AEA online submission system. Complete sessions: 3-4 papers, a discussant for each paper and a chair. Panels: 3-5 panelists with a two-page vita each. Workshops: abstract plus two-page vita per leader. Max. three submissions per participant. All participants expected to present in person.
membership_required: No (membership in any organization not required)
keynotes: Arik Levinson (Georgetown University); Jessica Goldberg (University of Maryland); a representative of the Federal Reserve Board of Governors
